h1: Laithong Hotel — an in-town Ubon hotel that still has a pool and a free airport shuttle
intro: Most hotels in central Ubon are towers without a pool — Laithong Hotel is the exception. It sits in the middle of town on Phichitrangsan Road, within walking distance of Thung Si Mueang park and the night market, and just minutes from the airport, yet it still has an outdoor pool, a children's pool and a free airport shuttle. It's a long-established property that renovated part of its rooms in 2024, with spacious rooms and big windows. Rates start from around THB 700/night.

body.html: What sets Laithong Hotel apart from other in-town Ubon hotels is that it has an outdoor pool and a children's pool despite being right in the city. Most properties in this area are walk-up blocks with rooms and little else, but Laithong has communal grounds, a small garden and a pool you can actually use. That makes it a good fit for families with kids, or anyone who wants an in-town hotel that's more than just a bedroom.

Location is what guests praise most. The hotel is on Phichitrangsan Road, about a 15-minute walk to Thung Si Mueang, the city's central park, and the Rachabut night market. The real bonus is how close it is to Ubon Airport (UBP) — just a few minutes by car — and the hotel runs a free airport shuttle plus free parking, which makes it convenient whether you fly in or drive yourself.
"Booked it for the free airport pickup. The room was bigger than expected, with a large window and good light, and the reception staff were lovely. Easy walk to Thung Si Mueang and the night market."

There are around 124 rooms, from Superior Twin up to Deluxe. The point guests agree on is that rooms are spacious, with high ceilings and large windows that let in natural light, and some have a separate sitting area. Each has a fridge, TV, free drinking water and air conditioning. Rooms renovated in 2024 are noticeably better, and the staff — friendly and multilingual — come up again and again in reviews in a good way.

Now the honest part — the hotel has been open a long time, and rooms that haven't been renovated show their age. Some reviews mention musty carpets, dated bathrooms and inconsistent cleaning, with the area under the bed sometimes missed. The pool is the other thing to flag: some reviews describe it as not always clear and not consistently maintained — if you're set on a proper swim, check the pool's condition at check-in first.

The scores help paint the picture. Laithong sits at around 8.0 on Trip.com and 3.5 stars on TripAdvisor (ranked #10 of 28 hotels in Ubon). Those numbers reflect the reality: good value and a good location, but not a brand-new hotel. Guests who get a renovated room tend to score it high, while those in older rooms grumble about condition — a gap you can see clearly across the reviews.

Bottom line: Laithong Hotel isn't a polished new property. It's a good-value in-town Ubon hotel with a pool and a free airport shuttle for under a thousand baht. It's ideal for travellers who fly into Ubon and want somewhere convenient close to the airport and the city centre, kids welcome. If you expect pristine 5-star finishes you may be disappointed, but for value lodging in central Ubon it's a sensible pick.

A tip from following the reviews here for a while: ask for a room renovated in 2024 when you book — the difference in condition is clear. If you're flying in, give your flight time ahead so you can use the free airport shuttle. And if you plan to use the pool, walk over and check its condition before you commit.

faq.q: Where is Laithong Hotel and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's on Phichitrangsan Road in the Thung Si Mueang area, central Ubon Ratchathani. It's about a 15-minute walk to Thung Si Mueang, Wat Thung Si Mueang and the Rachabut night market. It's also very close to Ubon Airport (UBP) — just a few minutes by car — and runs a free airport shuttle.

faq.q: How much does Laithong Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around THB 700/night for a Superior Twin. A Superior Double runs around THB 800, a Deluxe Room (renovated in 2024) around THB 950, and a family room/suite around THB 1,400. Rates move with the season and festivals, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does the hotel have a pool and an airport shuttle?
faq.a: Yes, both. Laithong is one of the in-town Ubon hotels that still has an outdoor pool and a children's pool, plus a free airport shuttle and free parking. That said, the pool isn't always well maintained, so it's worth checking its condition before you swim.

faq.q: Are the rooms dated, and which should I request?
faq.a: The hotel has been open a long time and only renovated part of its rooms in 2024. Un-renovated rooms show wear and some have a musty smell. Ask for a room renovated in 2024 (the Deluxe category) when you book or check in — the condition is clearly better.

faq.q: Who is Laithong Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for travellers flying into Ubon who want good-value lodging close to the airport and the city centre, and for families with children, thanks to the pool and kids' pool. It's less suited to anyone expecting a brand-new, pristine hotel in every room.

faq.q: What review score does Laithong Hotel have?
faq.a: It sits at around 8.0 on Trip.com and 3.5 stars on TripAdvisor, ranked #10 of 28 hotels in Ubon. Guests in renovated rooms tend to score it high, while those in older rooms note condition and cleanliness issues.
